# Welcome to my page!

My name is Lisa Lucky! I am 22 years old and currently in my final year at Dublin City University [(DCU)](https://www.dcu.ie/), pursuing a unique bachelor’s degree that combines my passions for business, language, and data analytics. My focus language is German, and I had the incredible opportunity to study abroad at the Technical University of Munich [(TUM)](https://www.tum.de/en/) during my third year, which further deepened my love for language and culture.
